<div style="float: {{{float|none}}}; clear:{{{clear|{{{float|both}}}}}};
            border: 2px solid black; background: {{{textbg|white}}};
            margin: {{#if:{{{float|}}}|1em|auto}}; 
               {{#ifeq:{{{float}}}|right|margin-right:0em;}}
               {{#ifeq:{{{float}}}|left|margin-left:0em;}}
            width: {{#if:{{{float|}}}|{{{width|35%}}}|{{{width|80%}}}}};">
<div style="background: {{{titlebg|#0a0}}}; padding: 0.3em 0.5em; border-bottom: 1px solid black; text-align: center; font-size:120%; color:{{{textcolor|#ffffff}}}">'''{{{1|Title}}}'''</div>
<div style="padding: 0 0.5em;">
{{{2|Body text}}}
</div>
</div>
<noinclude>

<pre>{{TipBox2|Title|Body Text|
   float=[left/right/none]|
   clear=[left/right/none]|
   textbg=[html color]|
   titlebg=[html color]|
   width=[css width]
}}
</pre>
